# 19 — Expected Artifacts Contract

## Always present in package
Notebook, prompts, source, tests, raw/clean data, audit data, docs, templates, manifest.

## Generated by P09/P10
`outputs/tables/perplexity_screening_summary.csv`, `perplexity_neighborhood_quality.csv`; screening embedding CSVs; sensitivity figures.

## Generated by P11
`p11_multiseed_quality.csv`, `p11_pairwise_seed_stability.csv`, `p11_candidate_robustness_summary.csv`, `p11_primary_alternative_selection.csv`, per-seed embeddings.

## Generated by P12
`final_optdigits_embedding_p<PRIMARY>.csv`, `final_configuration_p<PRIMARY>.csv`, `final_run_summary_p<PRIMARY>.csv`, `final_optimization_history_p<PRIMARY>.csv`, `final_neighborhood_quality_p<PRIMARY>.csv`, `final_neighborhood_quality_summary_p<PRIMARY>.csv`, final embedding/KL/gradient figures, reproducibility manifest.

Files in this section are runtime products and are not pre-filled with invented values.
